text: This report recommends three candidates for appointment to the Moss Park Arena Board.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following candidates to the Moss Park Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on September 20, 2027, and until successors are appointed: - Terence Mark - Jessica Polanski - Ethan Wright 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the supplementary report (October 16, 2023) from the City Clerk remain confidential in its entirety as it relates to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Moss Park Arena Board.
